title: Ushijima the Loan Shark Gets New 1-Shot Set 10 Years After Manga's End
content:
Manga creator Shohei Manabe announced on September 1 that he will draw a new one-shot for his Ushijima the Loan Shark manga. Manabe's announcement says the one-shot will have 38 pages, but the combined 42nd and 43rd issue of Shogakukan 's Weekly Big Comic Spirits magazine revealed on Monday that the one-shot will have 34 pages. The manga will be on display for an exhibition for the manga that is being held from September 19 through October 4 at Yurakucho Marui in Tokyo. Manabe stated there are no plans to release the one-shot outside of the exhibition.

The one-shot will be set 10 years after the end of the manga's story.

Manabe launched the manga in Weekly Big Comic Spirits in 2004, and ended the series in March 2019. The manga's 46th and final volume shipped in May 2019.

Youichi launched a spinoff manga titled Namerikawa-gumi Yakuza Meshi (Namerikawa Group's Yakuza Meals) in March 2025.

Yū Hayato launched the ongoing Yamikin Ushijima-kun Gaiden: Nikumamushi Densetsu (Ushijima the Loan Shark Side Story: The Legend of Nikumamushi) spinoff manga on Yawaraka Spirits in February 2017. Shogakukan published the manga's 26th volume on July 30.

Dōdō Yamazaki launched the Yamikin Ushijima-kun Gaiden: Ramen Namerikawa-san (Ushijima the Loan Shark Side Story: Ramen Namerikawa) spinoff manga also on Yawaraka Spirits in December 2017. The manga ended in its fifth volume in May 2019.

Satoshi Sasasani launched a spinoff manga titled Naniwa Time Leap Aizawa-kun (Osaka Time Traveling Aizawa-kun) in Shogakukan 's Monthly Spirits magazine in April 2024.

Yamazaki launched the ongoing Shōnen-in Ushijima-kun (Ushijima-kun in Penal School) spinoff manga on Shogakukan 's Manga ONE app in January 2023.

The main Ushijima the Loan Shark manga won in the General category of the 56th Shogakukan Manga Awards in 2011. The series was nominated for an Osamu Tezuka Culture Prize in 2008 and 2010, as well as for France's Angoulême Comics Awards in 2008.

The manga's live-action television series adaptation ran from October-December 2010, and the first film opened in August 2012. A second season premiered in January 2014, with a second film then premiering in May 2014. The third season premiered in July 2016, while the third film opened in Japan in September 2016. The fourth and final live-action film , Yamikin Ushijima-kun The Final , opened in Japan in October 2016. A live-action spinoff series titled Yamikin Ushijima-kun Gaiden Yamikin Saihara-san ( Ushijima the Loan Shark Side Story: Saihara the Loan Shark) premiered in Japan in September 2022.

title: Hello, I Am a Witch and My Crush Wants Me to Make a Love Potion! Reveals Main Trailer, Visual, Theme Songs and New Cast
content:
Hello, I Am a Witch and My Crush Wants Me to Make a Love Potion! anime revealed the main visual and trailer, as well as two additional cast members and the opening and ending theme songs. It’s set to premiere on October 5, 2026. The anime previously revealed a teaser visual in March. Keizo Kusakawa is directing the anime at studio diomedéa. Wataru Watari is handling the series composition, with Masakazu Ishikawa as the character designer, and Satoshi Matsumura as the music composer.

Mikako Komatsu voices Rose, while Yohei Azakami voices Harij. The new cast members are:

• Hiro Shimono as Tien

• Akira Sekine as Billaura

Centimillimental will perform the opening theme “Kanawanai,” while Reini will perform the ending theme “Mada Uso ni Naranai.” Both songs are featured in the main trailer, which also previews the voices of the main cast.

You can also see the main visual:

Based on the light novels by Eiko Mutsuhana, Hello, I Am a Witch and My Crush Wants Me to Make a Love Potion! follows Rose, known as the Witch of the Lake, after the knight Harij unexpectedly asks her to create a love potion. The problem is that Rose has secretly been in love with him herself. The series originally began as a web novel on the online publication platform Shosetsuka ni Naro, running from April 2019 to March 2020. Futabasha acquired the title and published it as a light novel featuring illustrations by Vient. The series also received a manga adaptation by Kamada in August 2020. Cross Infinite World is publishing the light novel in English, with Yen Press publishing the manga in English. Source: Hello, I Am a Witch and My Crush Wants Me to Make a Love Potion Official Website © Eiko Mutsuhana/Futabasha/Witch Love Potion Partners

title: Yu-Gi-Oh Returns With Surprise Anime Revival After 30 Years – Watch
content:
It’s been 30 years since Kazuki Takahashi’s Yu-Gi-Oh! originally made its debut in the pages of Shueisha’s Weekly Shonen Jump magazine, and the franchise has returned with a special anime remake to help celebrate. While it might have started out as a much darker series than what fans would recognize it as decades after, Yu-Gi-Oh! has become one of the most popular franchises to ever come from Shonen Jump thanks to its many sequels, spinoffs, and a real life trading card game keeping it alive with many updates.

Yu-Gi-Oh! is gearing up to launch a special exhibition in Japan to help commemorate the legacy of the late Kazuki Takahashi , and the franchise has gone all out for the occasion with a special anime revival highlighting the classic favorites in a cool new way after all these years. It’s a short that quickly teases what a modern day remake for the anime would look like, and you can check it out in action below.

Yu-Gi-Oh! Releases Special Anime Remake for New Exhibition

“YU-GI-OH! ART WORKS” is an official art exhibition showing off the late Kazuki Takahashi’s work opening in Japan beginning later this December, and unfortunately this is one of those events that will just be happening in Japan. At least fans get to celebrate in their own way with this new anime directed by Eri Osada for KONAMI animation with Takahiro Kagami providing the character designs, and Haruka Taira serving as art director for the short. It’s such a slick anime revival that it definitely raises more hopes for seeing a much fuller reboot in the future.

Yu-Gi-Oh! first made its debut within the pages of Shonen Jump magazine in 1996, but fans would likely recognize it more from the official anime adaptation. Though it really depends on which version of the anime you go back to. Yu-Gi-Oh! originally was a much darker series as Yugi Mutou and the Pharoah played deadly shadow games that had much higher stakes, and this was adapted into an anime by Toei Animation in 1998 . Often dubbed as “Season 0” by fans, this version of the franchise never got an official English language release.

What’s Next for the Yu-Gi-Oh! Anime?

Yu-Gi-Oh ! would then get an official reboot anime adaptation known as Yu-Gi-Oh! Duel Monsters back in 2000. This would be a version that focuses more on a trading card game introduced as a shadow game at first, but would prove to be so popular that Takahashi would then shift the focus of the rest of the series around it. This was the version of the anime that would make it to the rest of the world , and after 26 years, this is likely the version of the franchise that most fans recognize. It’s why this revival hits so hard after all this time.

As for the current state of the franchise, Yu-Gi-Oh! Go Rush!!! was the most recent iteration of the TV anime (being the eighth series overall). Wrapping up its run last year, it has yet to be revealed what form the anime would take with its next sequel, spinoff and more. But this short proves that there is a lot of cool material that fans of the classic would like to see it all in action again through a modern day lens.

title: Whisper of the Heart Opens in UK Cinemas This Week
content:
GKIDS will release Studio Ghibli 's 1995 film Whisper of the Heart , directed by Yoshifumi Kondō , in UK cinemas in the coming week. The 4K remastered film will appear on IMAX screens from Wednesday September 16, with a wider cinema release from Friday September 18. It will be released in both English-dubbed and subtitled versions. Screenings are listed at https://www.gkids.co.uk/tickets/ .

GKIDS released the (English-dubbed) trailer for Whisper of the Heart below, when it reissued the film in America earlier this year.

GKIDS describes Whisper of the Heart 's story:

"A chance encounter with a mysterious cat sends Shizuku, a girl with her head in the clouds, on a quest for her true talent. Together with Seiji, a boy determined to follow his dreams, and enchanted by The Baron, an antique cat figurine who guides her to listen to the whispers of her heart, Shizuku embarks on a life-changing adventure that takes her beyond the boundaries of her imagination. Based on a screenplay and storyboards from Hayao Miyazaki , Whisper of the Heart is a precious gem in the Studio Ghibli catalog, directed by veteran animator Yoshifumi Kondō ."

GKIDS ' next Ghibli cinema release after Whisper of the Heart will be Arrietty , directed by Hiromasa Yonebayashi , in both Japanese and English-dubbed versions. It will be released on Wednesday October 14 and 15 in IMAX cinemas in the UK and Ireland, followed by a wider cinema release from Friday October 16. As with Whisper of the Heart , the screening dates and venue details will be listed at https://www.gkids.co.uk/tickets/ .

title: Hindi Dub for Takopi's Original Sin Anime Streams on Ani-One India YouTube Channel
content:
Takopi's Original Sin premiered in Japan in June 2025. Takopi's Original Sin also streamed on the Ani-One Asia YouTube channel as it aired in Japan. Crunchyroll also streamed the anime in India as it aired in Japan. Crunchyroll describes the story:

A Happy alien, Takopi, lands on Earth with one mission: to spread happiness! When he meets Shizuka, a lonely fourth grader, he vows to bring back her smile using his magical Happy Gadgets. But as he uncovers the pain in her life, Takopi learns that true happiness may require more than gadgets.

Amazon Prime Video 's Anime Times service added the Hindi dub of the anime on October 16. The service added the anime in amongst its June-July 2025 releases.

The anime stars Kurumi Mamiya as Takopi and Reina Ueda as Shizuka Kuze. The cast also includes Konomi Kohara as Marina and Anna Nagase as Azuma.

Shinya Iino (director for Dr. Stone , Dr. Stone: Stone Wars ) directed the anime and oversaw the series scripts. Keita Nagahara (key animator for Violet Evergarden , Sound! Euphonium , Sonny Boy ) was the character designer. ENISHIYA produced the work.

The anime will get a compilation film with added new scenes that will open on November 27 in Japan.

Taizan 5 debuted the manga in Shueisha 's Shonen Jump+ in December 2021, and ended it in March 2022. Shueisha published the second and final compiled book volume in April 2022. Viz Media licensed the manga, and the series is also available in English on Shueisha 's MANGA Plus .

The manga was nominated for the 16th Manga Taisho Awards and the 27th Annual Tezuka Osamu Cultural Prizes in 2023. The series received the Manga Kingdom Tottori award at the 51st Japan Cartoonists Association Awards in 2022. The manga ranked at #3 in the Kono Manga ga Sugoi! (This Manga Is Amazing!) guidebook's top 20 manga for male readers list in 2022.
author: ANN

title: Kodansha's First Lineup of Indian-Printed Manga to be Announced in Early October 2026
content:
Japanese publishing company Kodansha announced its plans to print manga locally in India in June. It is aiming to publish 200 manga and other titles a year in Hindi and English. Kodansha plans to physically publish popular manga and children's books but will not publish e-books. It will also sell merchandise and organize events related to the IPs (intellectual properties) it publishes in India.

Kodansha India will be a joint venture with Japanese company Dai Nippon Printing (DNP) and Indian company IJ Kakehashi Services. Kodansha will contribute 81% of the company's capital, DNP will hold a 14% stake in the company, and IJ Kakehashi 5%.

Penguin Random House distributes Kodansha 's manga titles in India and has so far, only imported the United States editions of the books. Kodansha has previously granted publishing rights for children's books and other works in India to local companies.

Nikkei Asia reported in June Kodansha India hopes to bypass piracy with its new venture. Small e-commerce stores and street vendors in India often sell bootleg copies of popular manga titles from Kodansha USA , Viz Media , and Dark Horse Comics at a fraction of a price of the original.

Kodansha Ltd. launched its manga distribution service K Manga for Android, iOS, and browsers exclusively in the U.S. in May 2023 and it became available in India in February 2025.

Shima attended Bengaluru Comic-Con in November 2024 where she participated in live drawing sessions and autograph sessions with fans. The Kodansha Comics by Manga Planet India booth at Bengaluru Comic-Con gave out free copies of the first chapter of the manga to attendees of the event.

Manga Planet India, Kodansha , and JICA collaborated on the Manga Shakti Project in 2023. Manga Planet India provided participants of the research project with seven free manga titles during the course of the project with participants having a chance to win a one-month subscription to read Kodansha manga titles on Manga Planet India.

title: Chiikawa Anime Film Opens in the Philippines on September 30
content:
Medialink Entertainment announced on Sunday that it will release Eiga Chiikawa: Ningyo no Shima no Himitsu ( Chiikawa the Movie: The Secret of Mermaid Island), the first anime film adaptation of Nagano 's Chiikawa manga, in the Philippines on September 30.

The film opened in Japan on July 24, and ranked at #1 for its opening weekend. The film earned 990 million yen (about US$6.05 million) on its opening day. The film sold 1,508,500 tickets in its first three days, earning 2,240,333,500 yen (about US$13.70 million).

The film is based on the manga's arc posted on X (formerly Twitter ) from March to November 2023, nicknamed the "Siren Arc" or "Island Arc."

The film's story begins with Chiikawa and Hachiware relaxing, when a rabbit with a flyer on its face suddenly appears. Hachiware looks at the flyer, which reads, "Invitation to a special island." Lured by tempting promises including great rewards for simple hunts on the island and essentially free sweet and spicy dishes such as limited-edition island ramen and sweets, Chiikawa and friends decide to go to the island. Suspicious with the flyer, Rakko goes with them to the island. What awaits them when they arrive on the island?

Nagano is credited for the original story and also wrote the film's script. Under Nagano 's supervision, Kei Oikawa ( Uma Musume Pretty Derby 3 seasons, Hinamatsuri , My Teen Romantic Comedy SNAFU TOO! , My Teen Romantic Comedy SNAFU Climax ) directed the film at Cygames Pictures . QTORY inc. managed the production, and TOHO is distributing the film.

Makoto Tanaka , who voices Hachiware, performs the opening theme song "Kutsuzure" (Shoe Sore). Series creator Nagano wrote the lyrics.

Momoka Terasawa and Sayumi Suzushiro voice Hitoha and Futaba, respectively, the two islanders that Chii kawa and friends encounter.

title: Latest Crayon Shin-chan Film Becomes Highest-Grossing in Franchise
content:
The official website for Eiga Crayon Shin-chan Kikikaikai! Ora no Yōkai Bake-shon ( Crayon Shin-chan The Movie Super Strange! My Yōkai Monster Vacation), the 33rd 2D anime film in the Crayon Shin-chan series, announced on Monday that the film has earned over 2.7 billion yen (about US$17 million), a new record for box office earnings for the franchise . Director Masaki Watanabe shared an illustration to commemorate the new record and thank fans for watching:

The film centers on "the land of yōkai." The Nohara family go to Hiroshi's hometown of Akita to attend a famous fireworks festival during the summer. However, an incident causes yōkai to escape from their land and will wreak havoc in Akita, and in other areas throughout Japan. The Nohara family then go to the land of yōkai, and find themselves in a mysterious yet nostalgic world, where they go on an unpredictable adventure.

title: Hidari Yokoyama Launches Ayaru's Brush with Romance Manga
content:
Manga creator Hidari Yokoyama launched a new manga titled Ayaru's Brush with Romance ( Ippitsu Ayaru ) on Shueisha 's Shonen Jump+ service on Sunday. Shueisha 's MANGA Plus service is releasing the manga in English simultaneously.

MANGA Plus describes the manga:

Since his first name is written with an obscure kanji that's difficult to read, second-year high school student Ayaru Kagami has never once been called by it. Then one day, he falls in love with a girl in Shodo Club—Kyono Chinzei. Desperate to get closer to her, he joins the Shodo Club...and ink fills the pages of his adolescence with romance!

Yokoyama launched the Moebana manga on Shonen Jump+ in June 2022, and it ended in March 2023. Shueisha published the manga's first volume in September 2022, and the fourth and final volume in May 2023. The MANGA Plus service released the manga in English.

Yokoyama launched the Tsuruko Returns the Favor ( Tsuruko no Ongaeshi ) manga on Shonen Jump+ in August 2023, and ended it in May 2025. Shueisha released the manga's fifth and final volume in June 2025. MANGA Plus also released the manga in English.
author: ANN

title: NYCC Hosts Voice Actor Hikaru Midorikawa, Shonen Jump+ EIC Yuta Momiyama, More Guests, Events, Anime Premieres
content:
New York Comic Con is listing the following Japanese guests and events for its 2026 convention:

• Voice actor Hikaru Midorikawa ("ONE‑PUNCH MAN Special Panel: The Voice of Garou" on October 10 at 1:30 p.m. EDT)

• Editor-in-chief of Shonen Jump+ at Shueisha Yūta Momiyama, deputy editor-in-chief of Weekly Shōnen Magazine Yuta Hiraoka ("Taking Manga Global: MANGA Plus and K MANGA in the U.S." on October 8 at 4:30 p.m. EDT)

• Director Motonobu Hori, chief animation director/character designer Kōhei Tokuoka ("MARRIAGETOXIN Road to the Best Marriage! at NYCC" on October 8 at 5:15 p.m. EDT)

• Composer and arranger Evan Call (October 8 at 7:00 p.m. EDT)

• Voice actors Aoi Yūki, Takeo Ōtsuka ("The Apothecary Diaries Presented by Crunchyroll & NTV" on October 9 at 12:15 p.m. EDT)

• Director Yūta Shimotsu ("Junji Ito: Strange — 'Face Thief' U.S. Premiere & Director Q&A" on October 9 at 5:45 p.m. EDT)

• Author Rocket Shokai, illustrator Mephisto, voice actors Yōhei Azakami and Mayu Iizuka ("Sentenced to Be a Hero: Reflecting on Season 1 featuring Creator, Original Character Designer and Voice Cast" on October 9 at 6:30 p.m. EDT)

• "NARUTO Signing, with Junko Takeuchi (Japanese voice of Naruto Uzumaki) and Noriaki Sugiyama (Japanese voice of Sasuke Uchiha)" on October 10 at 10:45 a.m. EDT

• Gakuto Kajiwara ("Black Clover Season 2 Screening & Live Dubbing With Voice Cast" on October 10 at 12:45 p.m. EDT)

• Author Samuel Sattin, artist Acky Bright, editor Hisashi Sasaki ("VIZ Originals and the Future Superstars of Manga!" on October 10 at 12:45 p.m. EDT)

• "Kodansha Presents: The Fragrant Flower Blooms With Dignity Creator Saka Mikami" on October 10 at 1:15 p.m. EDT

• "GalaXic Baseball League Creator Acky Bright" on October 10 at 2:15 p.m. EDT and October 11 2:15 p.m. EDT

• "LYNX Signing with Writer Samuel Sattin and Artist Tokitokoro" on October 10 at 4:00 p.m. EDT

• Voice actors Junko Takeuchi, Noriaki Sugiyama ("NARUTO: What's Next?" on October 10 at 5:00 p.m. EDT)

• "Tokyo Revengers: Dive into the Latest Season – War of the Three Titans Arc, Episode 51 Screening & Talk with Mariya Ise" on October 11 at 1:45 p.m. EDT.

Premiere events not mentioned in the above list are as follows:

• "Dragon Ball Super: Beerus SPECIAL PANEL" world premiere advance screening on October 8 at 12:00 p.m. EDT

• "PONY CANYON Presents: First Look at TOUGEN ANKI & the World Premiere of Red Riding Hood: A Detective Story" on October 9 at 3:00 p.m. EDT

• "Crunchyroll Presents: Shangri-La Frontier Season 3 U.S. Premiere" on October 10 at 3:45 p.m. EDT

• "Crunchyroll Presents: Firefly Wedding & Dengeki Daisy Early Screenings" on October 10 at 7:30 p.m. EDT (Dengeki Daisy anime's United States premiere)

New York Comic Con 2026 is taking place at the Javits Center on October 8-11.
author: ANN
